meta.description: Agent / web-research curated SEA telecom intel. Merged into tele column at fetch time.

items.title: Vietnam eyes new 5G deals with Chinese tech firms despite US warnings
items.snippet: Mobifone in talks with Huawei; Viettel and VNPT signed 5G supply contracts with ZTE and Huawei. Ericsson and Nokia still supply core network.

items.title: Huawei and ZTE strengthen presence in Vietnam with new 5G network deal wins
items.snippet: Huawei consortium ~$23M 5G equipment contract; Viettel targeting 20,000 new 5G base stations in 2025. 11,000+ stations deployed nationwide.

items.title: EU warns Vietnam: Chinese 5G vendors may deter foreign investment
items.snippet: Ericsson and Nokia on core; Huawei and ZTE winning RAN/antenna contracts. EU Commissioner Sikela: 5G is the new battlefield for trusted vendors.

items.title: Huawei expands Vietnam footprint through energy, AI, and 5G partnerships
items.snippet: Partnerships spanning digital energy, AI, telecom infrastructure and industrial digitalization in Vietnam.

items.title: Cambodia launches 5G as all three mobile operators switch on networks
items.snippet: Cellcard, Metfone and Smart launched 5G from Jan 2026. Phased rollout from Phnom Penh and 14 provinces.

items.title: 1,500 5G base stations deployed in Cambodia's 5G race so far
items.snippet: Smart Axiata 674, Metfone (Viettel) 531, Cellcard 289 stations. Ministry accelerating mobile and FWA rollout.

items.title: Comin Asia and Nokia build sovereign AI infrastructure across Southeast Asia
items.snippet: AI-ready data centres planned for Cambodia and Laos; Nokia partnership for regional sovereign AI infrastructure.

items.title: Vietnam 5G median speed tops 500 Mbps for the first time; Viettel leads at 617 Mbps
items.title_orig: Mạng 5G Việt Nam lần đầu vượt 500 Mbps
items.snippet: VNNIC i-Speed Jan 2026: national 5G median 594.81 Mbps; Viettel 617 Mbps vs VNPT 311 Mbps and MobiFone 188 Mbps.

items.title: Viettel targets 98% population 5G coverage; adds 20,000 sites in 2026
items.title_orig: Viettel hướng tới phủ sóng 5G tới 98% dân số
items.snippet: Deputy CEO Le Quang Hieu at MWC 2026: ~30,000 5G SA sites by end-2025; planning +20,000 in 2026 for 98% coverage.

items.title: Viettel to trial 6G in 2028 with Qualcomm strategic alliance
items.title_orig: Viettel sẽ thử nghiệm 6G vào năm 2028
items.snippet: MWC 2026: Viettel joins Qualcomm 6G alliance; commercial 6G target from 2029; co-develop premium AI smartphones.

items.title: Vietnam pursues new 5G deals with China despite US warnings
items.title_orig: Việt Nam nhắm thỏa thuận 5G mới với Trung Quốc, bất chấp cảnh báo của Mỹ
items.snippet: BBC Vietnamese: Mobifone negotiating with Huawei; Viettel/VNPT already signed with ZTE and Huawei for 5G equipment.

items.title: Despite US warnings, Vietnam plans more 5G contracts with Chinese vendors
items.title_orig: 不顾美国警告 越南拟与中企签更多5G网络合约
items.snippet: Zaobao: Mobifone tender favors Chinese firms; Huawei 5G gear seen near US Consulate in HCMC; follows Viettel/VNPT ZTE/Huawei deals.

items.title: Huawei and ZTE win 5G contracts in Vietnam; Ericsson and Nokia retain core
items.title_orig: 消息称华为中兴在越南斩获5G合同
items.snippet: C114: Huawei $23M consortium deal; ZTE $20M+ antenna contracts; Nordic vendors on core; ~11,000 5G sites cover 26% population.

items.title: Vietnam 5G mass deployment opens platform for app developers
items.title_orig: 越南5G大规模部署：为应用程序开发搭建新平台
items.snippet: VietnamPlus Chinese: Viettel 30,000 5G sites, 90% outdoor coverage; Huawei expert praises fast 5G e-commerce adoption.

items.title: Cambodia 5G trial: Cellcard leads download speeds in early Ookla tests
items.title_orig: អ៊ីនធើណិត 5G សាកល្បងជំហានដំបូងនៅកម្ពុជា
items.snippet: AMS Khmer: Ookla trial shows Cellcard 548 Mbps, Smart 336 Mbps, Metfone 218 Mbps; 1,500+ 5G sites by March 2026.

items.title: Cellcard doubles 5G footprint to 500+ sites, targets 1,000 by end-July
items.snippet: Cellcard CSX-listed operator: 500+ 5G BTS deployed since Jan 2026 launch; accelerating toward 1,000 sites across Phnom Penh and central region.
